title: JANUS — Project Blue Book Questionnaire Statistical Context
purpose: Preserve the historically documented human-questionnaire layer behind Project Blue Book and define which witness variables are sufficiently structured to support the JANUS temporal specificity test.

historical_questionnaire_scale.source: Project Blue Book status reports / U.S. Air Force historical record
historical_questionnaire_scale.finding: During the extremely high reporting period in summer 1952, trial questionnaires were sent to selected civilian letters reporting sightings. The status report states that approximately 1,000 completed questionnaires were returned and incorporated into the IBM statistical analysis.
historical_questionnaire_scale.interpretive_boundary: This documents a large structured witness-report layer; it does not mean the questionnaire respondents were a random population sample and therefore does not provide population prevalence without a denominator.

special_report_14_statistically_usable_v.source: Project Blue Book Special Report 14 / Battelle statistical analysis
special_report_14_statistically_usable_v.report_statement_summary: The report notes that many potentially interesting variables were too subjective or incomplete for meaningful correlation analysis. The variables retained as statistically usable included date, time, location, duration, reliability and method of observation, plus physical attributes such as number, color, speed, shape, light brightness and identification/evaluation.

primary_components: point-like or unresolved luminous appearance in narrative/case summary
star_like_operationalization.important_rule: The word star is neither required nor sufficient. A STARLIKE_WITNESS label is a morphology label, not an identification or origin claim.

sampling_warning.reason: Blue Book questionnaires were triggered by people who had already reported an event. The data estimate properties and timing of reports entering the system, not the fraction of the general population seeing anomalies.
sampling_warning.required_denominator_for_prevalence: A genuine contemporaneous population survey with a defined sampling frame would be needed to estimate prevalence of sightings in the public.

nuclear_test_use.allowed: Join occurrence dates to frozen nuclear dates after morphology/source coding and compare matched nuclear and non-nuclear dates.
nuclear_test_use.forbidden: Do not select or relabel witness cases because they fall near a nuclear test, and do not infer causation from temporal coincidence alone.
